tasks.title: Corner frequency
tasks.statement: The motor time constant in a first-order model is **{T} ms**. Find the corner frequency (Hz).

tasks.title: Filter and delay phase
tasks.statement: At **{f} Hz**, find the phase lag (in degrees, as a positive number) from a PT1 filter with a cutoff frequency of **{fc} Hz** and a pure delay of **{tau} ms** combined.
